poses.caption: Lie on the side with the lower arm extended overhead and top hand lightly behind the head.
Crunch the top elbow toward the hip while keeping legs grounded, then return to the stretch and switch sides.

jobs.detail: SIDE STRETCH CRUNCH, TWO equal SQUARE cells SIDE BY SIDE wide landscape, same FRONT-side three-quarter view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT. Lie on LEFT SIDE on gray mat, both legs extended straight stacked together and resting floor BOTH phases, pelvis remains on lateral hip grounded, no leg lift. LEFT bottom arm STRAIGHT extends OVERHEAD along mat to image LEFT past head, left elbow straight palm relaxed down, this arm remains on mat unchanged in both phases. RIGHT top hand LIGHTLY behind head near right ear elbow open, no neck pulling. LEFT STRETCH: torso lengthened lying low, head aligned spine near bottom extended arm, right elbow away from hip. RIGHT CRUNCH: laterally bend ribs toward right hip to lift shoulders/head moderately off mat, right top elbow moves toward right hip, pelvis and both straight legs stay on floor, left bottom arm STILL extended overhead on mat, not propping on forearm. Neck follows torso neutral. Primary abdominal red ONE diffuse smooth BLURRED patch over intact side BLACK shirt, not back/chest, broad natural cloth folds only, fine exposed arms/calves grayscale. No rolling onto back/seated position, no knee bend.

poses.caption: Lie supine with one foot planted and the other leg extended straight.
Drive through the planted heel to lift the hips, squeeze the glute, then lower with control; finish repetitions and switch legs.

jobs.detail: SINGLE-LEG GLUTE BRIDGE, TWO equal SQUARE cells SIDE BY SIDE same SIDE three-quarter view head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT. Supine on thin gray mat, back of skull rests DIRECTLY mat eyes ceiling relaxed neutral neck, upper shoulders grounded in both phases, arms at sides palms flat. LEFT supporting foot planted flat under bent LEFT knee; RIGHT leg extended STRAIGHT in air at roughly45degrees, right knee extended, unsupported right shoe NEVER floor. LEFT LOWER: pelvis rests mat, left knee bent and left shoe floor, right straight leg lifted. RIGHT BRIDGE: drive left heel to raise pelvis until shoulder-HIP-LEFT KNEE one straight line, left shoe SAME position, right leg remains straight extended following slope of left thigh upward, right shoe in air. Same supporting leg and opposite straight leg both phases, no hip twist, no excessive lumbar arch, skull not lifted, no head on ponytail. Hair flattened behind head away from under skull. Primary LEFT GLUTE ONLY one smooth diffuse BLURRED red tint over intact BLACK shorts at posterior supporting hip, no fiber rays/cutaway. Exposed arm/calf muscles fine grayscale, full opaque shirt/shorts seat/crotch.
